goal: Integrate the accepted seq120 Fresh-Agent report and make plain-language L3/L4 user escalation plus durable worker handoff a permanent Agent-wide operating rule before the first real multi-industry pilot.
baseline_impact: none; this strengthens the decision/escalation process without changing any locked Architecture Baseline v1 semantic
acceptance: The seq120 genuine external Fresh-Agent v3 report is preserved unchanged and maintainer-accepted only if its subject HEAD, cue digests, stage ordering, read boundaries and report-only mutation provenance remain valid.
Every Agent role inherits a permanent rule to stop the Baseline-changing portion of potential L3/L4 work and first give the user a six-question plain-language decision brief.

Parallel workers persist potential/confirmed L3/L4 decisions in a workstream-local escalation file and route its repository path through integration_requests rather than rewriting global handoff or creating a local semantic fork.
Global handoff advances from seq120 continuity closure to seq121 pilot coordination and records the accepted drill plus the bounded escalation protocol without reopening Architecture Baseline v1.
No product implementation, schema, Baseline invariant or semantic-owner definition changes are made.
